parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the account to be created.

parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the account. The password must be 6 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters (!@#$&%^*()_+-=).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.
